about_the_game:
Explore the new level featured in the Legendary Edition of Ravenlok: The Labyrinth!

This edition introduces exciting new content, offering players expanded gameplay with new areas and challenges. Key features include:

  • 5 expansive new areas

  • 4 challenging new bosses

  • Additional enemies and NPCs

  • Revamped combat mechanics

  • A brand-new Musketeer outfit

  • New weapons

  • And much more!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel 2.0 Ghz or higher
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVDIA GTX 900 Series or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel 3.0 Ghz or higher
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVDIA GTX 10 Series or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 MB available space

short_description: Embark on an enchanting journey in Ravenlok, an action-packed fairytale adventure about a young heroine destined to fulfill a perilous prophecy.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America
